title: Intuition & Non-Physical Teachers
description: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the transformative nature of the new consciousness, which moves beyond the limits of the five senses and embraces a deeper awareness of non-physical reality.
He introduces the role of intuition , which unlike in the old consciousness where it was seen as mere “hunches,” is now an essential guide for spiritual growth .
Gary emphasizes the importance of approaching life from a place of love rather than fear, explaining that this choice fuels the creation of authentic power .
As you listen, you’ll learn practical ways to harness intuition in daily life, interact with non-physical Teachers, and align your actions with love.
Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Senses? Learn how here.
